faq.heading: Questions clients ask before we start

items.question: How do I start a project with Tech A-Nap?
items.answer: Submit your project details through the form or message us on LINE. We'll get back to you within one business day to talk through the details.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on scope. An MVP typically takes a few weeks; larger systems are broken into phases, each with a clear delivery date.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-launch support, including fixes and new feature development, based on what we agree on.

items.question: Do you work with international clients?
items.answer: Yes. Our team communicates fluently in English and can schedule meetings around your time zone.
